children: Bitcoin and gold rose as the yen strengthened sharply and the U.S. dollar weakened across markets. According to PANews, Bitcoin was trading at $78,535.67.

The report said the move in the yen has weighed on the dollar index and helped lift dollar-denominated assets such as Bitcoin. It added that a weaker dollar typically supports assets priced in dollars and can ease global financial conditions, while a stronger dollar often pressures Bitcoin.

The article also warned that a disorderly and rapid rise in the yen could trigger large-scale unwinding of yen carry trades. It said traders have borrowed low-cost yen for more than a decade to buy stocks, bonds and cryptocurrencies, and that a sharp yen rally could force foreign investors buying Japanese equities with borrowed yen, as well as domestic traders using cheap yen for overseas assets, to liquidate positions.

title: Bitcoin and Gold Rise as Yen Strengthens and Dollar Weakens
